source_text: הֲ/ל֧וֹא אַתָּ֣ה מִ/קֶּ֗דֶם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛/י קְדֹשִׁ֖/י לֹ֣א נָמ֑וּת יְהוָה֙ לְ/מִשְׁפָּ֣ט שַׂמְתּ֔/וֹ וְ/צ֖וּר לְ/הוֹכִ֥יחַ יְסַדְתּֽ/וֹ׃
english_snapshot: Are you not from of old, O Yahweh my God, my Holy One? We will not die.[a] O Yahweh, you have appointed him for judgment, and you, O Rock, have established him for reproof.

signals.text: Or, following an alternative reading preserved in some traditions: “You do not die.” The Hebrew Masoretic Text reads “We will not die.”
